segments.comment: A gnomish Healer (so the Mines' gnomes stay peaceful) level-teleports to Minetown in debug mode, wishes for a credit card and a lock pick, steps beside a locked door that is not trapped, and creates a peaceful watchman. The watchman sees the credit card at work and yells (monmove.c watch_on_duty), setting D_WARNED in rm.looted, which rm.h overlays on flags, where D_WARNED equals D_TRAPPED. Picking the lock again with the lock pick succeeds, and lock.c picklock() then sets off the door trap: 'KABOOM!!  The door was booby-trapped!'
